summary: Timeboxed handoff of sanitized customer telemetry to Finance for SOX evidence
description:
Issue summary: Finance compliance has requested a timeboxed delivery of minimal, de-identified telemetry slices tied to three invoices for Q4 audits. The request is for token-level aggregate metrics and a tiny sample of sanitized request/response metadata (no original prompt text or PII).

Impact: Regulatory audit required by Finance. No customer-facing outage, but we must produce verifiable artifacts within 5 business days to satisfy auditors.

Requested scope: - Aggregate token counts per invoice ID (provided by Finance) for two billing periods. - Sampled request metadata: timestamp, model-id, route-id, response-latency, anonymized session-hash. - Zero original user content; all textual payloads must be removed or replaced with deterministic hashes per our redaction SOP.

Acceptable outputs: CSVs with columns as above, plus a short README describing redaction method and hash salt (KMS escrow reference). Outputs must be stored in a timeboxed S3 bucket with read ACL to Finance auditors for 30 days.

Compliance controls required: - Security review and approval (Security) - Redaction verification and checksum (Privacy) - Audit trail: who pulled data and when (SRE) - Minimal privileged access, ephemeral credentials, and deletion policy (AccessOps)

Environment: prod-us-east (token-level telemetry derived from production serving runtime).

Decision notes so far: Requester (Finance) accepts de-identified aggregates only. Legal confirmed SOX scope but requires chain-of-custody documentation.

Requested by: Ben Alvarez (Finance)

Owner: Jordan Patel (Platform Support)
comments: 2026-03-12 10:03 - Maya Chen (Reporter): Initiated request after Finance pinged Compliance channel. Attached invoice IDs: INV-2024-Q4-001, INV-2024-Q4-017, INV-2024-Q4-023. Asked for five-day turnaround. Requesting Security and Privacy sign-off before any extracts.

2026-03-12 11:15 - Security (Aisha Rahman): Acknowledged. Need to confirm redaction recipe and KMS escrow plan. Will triage today. Tentative list of fields NOT allowed to appear in any output: raw_prompt, raw_response, user_email, api_key, ip_address.

2026-03-12 13:40 - Privacy (Carl Ng): Will perform deterministic hashing review and run synthetic tests against sample payloads. Recommend sample size <= 250 sessions per invoice, sampled uniformly by session start time.

2026-03-12 16:02 - Jordan Patel (Assignee): Planning extraction steps: 1) narrow telemetry query by invoice tag, 2) run redaction pipeline in staging mirror, 3) produce CSVs and README, 4) request Security to validate. ETA: 2026-03-17 EOD if approvals are fast.

2026-03-13 09:21 - SRE (Lena Ortiz): Confirmed we can create a timeboxed S3 bucket with expiring credentials and object-level access logs enabled. Will add a short CloudTrail snippet to demonstrate chain-of-custody.

2026-03-13 14:05 - Legal (Priya Singh): Confirmed SOX relevance. We need a signed attestation from Finance that they will not attempt to re-identify any customers from provided artifacts. Attestation template linked in Confluence.

2026-03-14 08:31 - Security (Aisha Rahman): Reviewed redaction test results from staging run. Found two telemetry keys that could leak region-specific hostnames; patched redaction config and re-ran. Clean output confirmed. Approving timeboxed extract contingent on attestation and presence of KMS escrow log.

2026-03-14 09:14 - Jordan Patel (Assignee): Uploaded final CSVs to s3://redwood-secure-handoffs/INT-999888/ and attached README. Temps creds issued to ben.alvarez@finance.redwood with 72-hour access window. Notified Finance and Legal. Marking for resolution after attestation is returned.
2026-03-14 12:44 - Ben Alvarez (Finance): Received files and KMS logs. Signed attestation sent to legal@redwood.ai. Thanks to the team for quick turnaround.
resolution: Timeboxed handoff completed: sanitized CSVs delivered, attestation obtained, S3 bucket scheduled for automatic deletion in 30 days. Security and Privacy approvals recorded. Chain-of-custody artifacts stored in Confluence link.
